trap-negation-contrast.evidence: table( block with 7 numeric rows plus one italic prose sentence. The prose sentence is the absolute-mass-excision disclaimer ('absolute mass in MeV is not a framework prediction; the residual is the quantity of interest') -- I adjudicated it under all ten categories and it is clean: a factual scope statement of the 2026-08-11 ruling, the documented false-positive class, not manufactured contrast. RECOMPUTED the arithmetic: 938.272 - 936.994 = 1.278 exactly as printed; 1.278/m_e = 2.5009836; the correction factor 1 + [2]_q*hbar_q^2 = 1.019741349 at the proton pin.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: THREE ARITHMETIC FINDINGS (minor, none change a conclusion). (1) The 'ratio' row is a rounding of a rounding: 2.5009836/2.5 = 1.00039344, but the printed 1.00036 is 2.5009/2.5, i.e. computed from the already-truncated 2.5009. The true figure is 1.00039 (+0.039%); the accompanying 'sub-0.04%' survives, but only just. (2) Delta m_p/m_e = 2.5009836 is printed 2.5009, a truncation -- rounding gives 2.5010. (3) The two mass rows do not round-trip as printed: 955.49/1.019741349 = 936.9925, not the printed 936.994. Consistency requires the raw tower mass to be about 955.4915, so the displayed 955.49 is a rounded value that cannot regenerate the displayed corrected value. Proposed fix: print one more digit on the raw row, or footnote that the correction was applied to the unrounded value.
